subject: 明代江南客栈（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Song southern building sprite into a Ming Jiangnan regional variant, preserve the layout, transparent cutout, realistic fine material detail and subdued visual density. Two-storey traveller inn 12m east-west by9m north-south, L-shaped timber gallery building around a small forecourt, grouped guest-room lattice doors, plain broad entrance facing lower-left, white plaster gables, dark grey roof, one small blank fabric hanging. No horses or people. True transparent RGBA background; outside silhouette alpha zero. NO halo, ambient beige smudge, backdrop, fog, white matte, scenery, text, watermark, people or modern objects. Full roof and ground rim inside canvas with generous10% clear margin, one asset only.
